groups.title: How detection works
groups.intro: There are 4 main types of detector. Each one finds different things. Find your type first, then ask us about price.

groups.intro: Three good options for each type of customer.

how-basic.title: Basic metal detectors
how-basic.callout: If you are a **BEGINNER** and want to find coins, jewelry or relics, start here.
how-basic.finds: Coins, jewelry, relics and other metal
how-basic.explanation: Easy detectors for coins, jewelry and relics. Some use one frequency (VLF). Others, like the Ace Apex and Manticore, use several frequencies at the same time (multi-frequency). A target ID on the screen helps you dig more good targets and less trash.

how-gold-nugget.title: Gold nugget detectors
how-gold-nugget.callout: If you are a **SERIOUS GOLD PROSPECTOR** looking for small nuggets in mineralized ground, look here.
how-gold-nugget.explanation: Made for natural gold in the goldfields. The Gold Finder 2000 and Gold Monster 1000 work automatically: switch on and go. The GPX 6000 uses pulse induction (GeoSense-PI) to find all forms of gold.

how-ground-scanner.title: 3D ground scanners
how-ground-scanner.callout: If you are looking for **TREASURE CHESTS, CAVITIES or TUNNELS**, a 3D scanner shows you an image of the ground.
how-ground-scanner.explanation: The device scans the ground and builds a 3D image of what is below. You can watch it live on the screen. The OKM models also include VLF detection and extra scan modes.

how-mineral-gpr.title: Mineral scanners & GPR
how-mineral-gpr.callout: If you run a **MINING OPERATION** or a big survey and need to look deep into the ground, start here.
how-mineral-gpr.finds: Cavities, tunnels, pipes and deep objects
how-mineral-gpr.explanation: GPR means ground penetrating radar. The OKM Gepard GPR 3D shows results as a live stream or a ground scan. The GER Titan X13 combines 11 search systems in one device.

level-beginner.title: Beginner
level-beginner.callout: If you are a **BEGINNER** and want to start metal detecting, choose a simple machine first.
level-beginner.bestFor: Your first detector: park, field and beach
level-beginner.explanation: These models are simple to set up. The Vanquish 340 is made for anyone starting out. The X-TERRA PRO has Park, Field and Beach modes: pick your place and start.

level-prospector.title: Serious nugget prospector
level-prospector.callout: If you are a **SERIOUS GOLD PROSPECTOR** working in hard, mineralized ground, look at these.
level-prospector.finds: Gold nuggets, from large to very small
level-prospector.explanation: The Goldmaster 24K uses a ground tracking system (XGB) for stable work. The Axiom uses pulse timings made for extreme mineralized soil. The GPZ 7000 is made for depth and sensitivity on all gold (manufacturer claim).

level-mining.title: Mining operation
level-mining.callout: If you run a **MINING OPERATION** or search large areas, look at multi-system devices.
level-mining.finds: Gold, precious metals and buried treasure
level-mining.bestFor: Teams who want several search systems in one device
level-mining.explanation: These devices put several search systems in one unit. The Titan GER-1000 and Deep Seeker each have 5 search systems. The Gold Seeker uses pulse induction to tell precious from non-precious metals.

specialty-security.title: Security screening
specialty-security.callout: If you run **SECURITY** at an airport, event, mall or prison, these check people and bags.
specialty-security.finds: Guns, coins and all metal on people. Items inside bags (X-ray).
specialty-security.explanation: Hand-held scanners check one person at a time, with sound or silent vibration alerts. Walk-through gates like the PD 6500i check people as they walk in. The X-ray scanner shows what is inside bags and parcels without opening them. Also available: under-vehicle inspection mirror.

specialty-xrf.title: XRF gold & metal testers
specialty-xrf.callout: If you **BUY OR SELL GOLD** and need to check purity, an XRF analyzer tests metal at the push of a button.
specialty-xrf.explanation: The Niton DXL is made for shops. The handheld Niton XL2 and Vanta Element are rugged and sealed against dust and moisture. The Vanta Element gives precise alloy identification.

specialty-long-range.title: Long-range locators
specialty-long-range.callout: If you want to **SEARCH A WIDE AREA** from one place, ask us about long-range locators.
specialty-long-range.finds: Manufacturer states: gold, precious metals, diamonds and cavities
specialty-long-range.bestFor: Customers who want to search wide areas
specialty-long-range.explanation: The manufacturer states these German-made devices use several search systems and an adjustable forward range. Results depend on the ground and conditions and are not guaranteed. Ask us on WhatsApp what they can and cannot do.

specialty-water.title: Water detectors
specialty-water.callout: If you are looking for **UNDERGROUND WATER** or a place for a well, see these.
specialty-water.finds: Manufacturer states: groundwater, fresh and salt water, artesian wells
specialty-water.explanation: The manufacturer states these long-range devices have separate fresh-water and salt-water modes. Results depend on the ground and conditions and are not guaranteed.

specialty-gems.title: Diamond & gem testers
specialty-gems.callout: If you **BUY OR SELL DIAMONDS**, check every stone before you pay.
specialty-gems.finds: Real diamonds vs. moissanite and simulants
specialty-gems.explanation: Pocket-sized testers. The Multi Tester III uses thermal and electrical properties to separate diamonds from moissanite. The Diamond Mate checks diamonds by their thermal properties.

specialty-mining-equipment.title: Mining equipment
specialty-mining-equipment.callout: If you already work a gold area and want to **PROCESS MORE SOIL**, see this equipment.
specialty-mining-equipment.finds: Gold from dry soil, creeks and streams
specialty-mining-equipment.bestFor: Prospectors who process soil on site
specialty-mining-equipment.explanation: The Drywasher is for dry ground. The Highbanker is a 54-inch wide sluice box for creeks and streams.
